app.comment: Hold a key, speak, and the text is typed where your cursor is
macos.mic_usage: PressVoice records your voice while you hold the hotkey and sends it to OpenAI to turn it into text.
installer.autostart: Start PressVoice automatically when Windows starts
notify.welcome.title: Welcome to PressVoice
notify.welcome.body: Paste your OpenAI API key to start dictating.
notify.ready.title: PressVoice is ready
notify.no_key.title: No API key
notify.no_key.body: Paste your OpenAI API key in Settings.
notify.wayland.title: Wayland session
notify.wayland.body: Global hotkeys only work in X11 apps under Wayland. Log in with an X11 session for full support.
notify.audio_stuck.title: Audio stuck
notify.audio_stuck.body: Restarting PressVoice to recover the microphone.
notify.hotkey_unavailable.title: Hotkey unavailable
notify.mic_blocked.title: Windows is blocking the microphone
notify.mic_error.title: Microphone error
notify.mic_error.body_windows: Could not open the microphone ({error}). Click to open the Windows microphone settings.
notify.mic_error.body: Could not open the microphone ({error}). Choose another one in PressVoice Settings.
notify.empty.title: Empty recording
notify.empty.body: No audio captured — check the microphone in PressVoice Settings.
notify.no_sound.title: No sound from the microphone
notify.no_sound.body: Check that the microphone works and isn't muted.
notify.error.title: Error
notify.paste_refused.title: Couldn't paste here
notify.paste_refused.body: The text is on the clipboard — press Ctrl+V.
notify.copied.title: Copied — press ⌘V to paste
notify.copied.body: To paste automatically, turn on PressVoice in {path} (opened for you).
notify.model_unavailable.title: Model unavailable
notify.model_unavailable.body: {model} can't be used with this key — using {fallback}.
notify.style_failed.title: Style failed
windows.toggle.desktop: Let desktop apps access your microphone
windows.policy: Microphone access is disabled by an administrator policy
error.invalid_key: Invalid API key — check it in Settings
error.quota: OpenAI quota exceeded — check billing on platform.openai.com
error.rate_limit: Too many requests — try again in a moment
error.timeout: OpenAI didn't answer in time — try again
error.connection: No connection to OpenAI — check the internet
settings.title: PressVoice — Settings
settings.refresh_tooltip: Fetch the latest transcription models from OpenAI
settings.models_hint: Refresh fetches new models as soon as OpenAI releases them.
settings.no_models: This key has no transcription models.
settings.test_tooltip: Record 1.5 seconds and check the level
mode.push_to_talk: Push-to-talk — hold the key while speaking
mode.toggle: Toggle — press to start, press again to stop
text_mode.whole: All at once — after you finish speaking
text_mode.phrases: By phrase — each phrase after a pause, while you speak
settings.text_mode_hint: By phrase types each phrase while you speak, with the model above. Styles apply only to all-at-once text.
mic_test.no_audio: The microphone opened but sent no audio.
mic_test.silence: Only digital silence: the system is blocking the microphone, or it is muted.
mic_test.quiet: Very quiet — speak during the test or raise the input volume.
styles.title: PressVoice — Styles
styles.name: Name:
styles.prompt_placeholder: Instructions for the AI, e.g. “Fix grammar and punctuation, keep the original language.”
